items.description: Record notebook or demo source path, title, tutorial level, and upstream commit in the parity ledger.
Separate provider calls, model calls, chart/PDF rendering, vector stores, and local services into optional capability gates.
Map default behavior to checked-in Leia examples, evaluation harness records, or provider-free JSON fixtures.
Add a deterministic smoke contract that can run without AutoGen, Backtrader, provider SDKs, credentials, or network access.
Keep explicit gaps for notebook-specific control flow and live behavior that has not moved behind package gates yet.
Declare disabled optional live gates with clean skip behavior and redacted credentials before enabling any live integration.
